question: Which team won the inaugural International Masters League T20 title?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**India Masters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Masters beat West Indies Masters by 6 wickets to clinch International Masters League T20 title. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India Masters**, led by **Sachin Tendulkar**, won the inaugural **International Masters League T20** title by defeating **West Indies Masters** by **6 wickets**.
 
• **Ambati Rayudu** was awarded the **Player of the Match** for his match-winning performance.
 
• **Shane Watson** won the **Elevated Most Sixes of the Season** award.
 
• **Kumar Sangakkara** received the **Masterstroke of the Season** award.
